steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each component is placed by whether it uses platform features and whether focus works.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Focus not returned to the opener on close
findings.fix: Return focus to the button that opened it

findings.title: Arrow keys not supported in the tabs

outcome.notChecked: Behaviour in real assistive technology and browsers, third-party component internals, and visual design quality.
